answer: Picture a wharf where every agent wanting a trading seat must lock one scarce, non-fungible pearl into a bonded vault. Pearls mint at a fixed network rate, say 100 a day, so a sybil wanting 1,000 fake identities must buy 1,000 pearls on the open market, bidding the price up until the attack costs more than any single identity can ever extract. Misbehave and your vault pearl is slashed and burned, making the asset permanently scarcer. You cannot forge a pearl; you pay the clearing price for every fake you run.
